notes: BUU 2.2.0 - new 'Read field' step. Read a value off the page (e.g. a WonStatus dropdown) without changing anything: it captures BOTH the raw value (V) and the visible label (Void); for text boxes it reads the text. You name an output column, and that name becomes a {{token}} you can use in LATER steps (it only appears for steps below the read step, with a warning if referenced too early). Results write to their OWN spreadsheet (separate from the run log) in upcoming/results/, named mmddyyyy_HHmm_<flowname>.xlsx, with OP ID/URL + each read column (label + raw) per row. Lets you build a 'read each lead's status' flow with login/logout you control. Also: the Upload file step (attach a file per row via a file input) was already present and is ready to use. Built on 2.1.2 (bulletproof logout, login-overlay fix, per-worker stop, setup/teardown scope).
